name: conversations_replies
description: Retrieve a thread of messages posted to a conversation: the parent identified by ts plus every reply whose thread_ts points at it (GET /conversations.replies)

channel.description: Conversation ID (C…) or a #channel-name to fetch the thread from.

ts.description: Unique identifier of either a thread's parent message or a message in the thread, e.g. 1786312800.000101.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 100.
